name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Telangana
benefits: Rs 12,000 per acre per year (Rs 6,000 per season) direct investment support to land-owning farmers.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 0.5 acres; age >= 18; annual family income <= Rs 5,00,000.

translations.te: తెలంగాణ రైతు భరోసా — ఎకరాకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 12,000 పంట పెట్టుబడి సహాయం.
translations.hi: तेलंगाना रैतु भरोसा — किसानों को प्रति एकड़ ₹12,000 वार्षिक निवेश सहायता।
translations.kn: ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ರೈತು ಭರೋಸಾ — ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಎಕರೆಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 12,000 ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ನೆರವು.
translations.ta: தெலங்கானா ரைத்து பரோசா — விவசாயிகளுக்கு ஏக்கருக்கு ஆண்டு ரூ.12,000 உதவி.

name: Rythu Bandhu (Legacy Superseded)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Telangana
benefits: Rs 10,000 per acre per year investment support (superseded by Rythu Bharosa).
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Farmer with land >= 0.5 acres; age >= 18.

translations.te: రైతు బంధు (పాత పథకం — రైతు భరోసా ద్వారా భర్తీ చేయబడింది).
translations.hi: रैतु बंधु (पुराना संस्करण — रैतु भरोसा द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित)।
translations.kn: ರೈತು ಬಂಧು (ಹಳೆಯ ಯೋಜನೆ).
translations.ta: ரைத்து பந்து (பழைய திட்டம்).

name: Telangana Mahalakshmi Scheme
ministry: Dept of Women Development & Child Welfare, Telangana
benefits: Rs 2,500/month (Rs 30,000/year) financial assistance to women heads of household + Rs 500 LPG cylinder + free TSRTC bus travel.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Female; age 18 to 65; annual family income <= Rs 2,00,000; BPL / White Ration Card holder.

translations.te: మహాలక్ష్మి పథకం — మహిళలకు నెలకు రూ. 2,500 ఆర్థిక సహాయం, రూ. 500 గ్యాస్ సిలిండర్ మరియు ఉచిత ఆర్టీసీ బస్సు ప్రయాణం.
translations.hi: महालक्ष्मी योजना — तेलंगाना की महिलाओं को ₹2,500/माह वित्तीय सहायता और ₹500 गैस सिलेंडर।
translations.kn: ಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಯೋಜನೆ — ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ರೂ. 2,500 ಸಹಾಯ.
translations.ta: மகாலட்சுமி திட்டம் — தெலங்கானா பெண்களுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.2,500 உதவி.

name: Telangana Rythu Bima (Farmer Life Insurance)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Telangana
benefits: Rs 5,00,000 life insurance cover paid by Govt of Telangana (zero premium for farmer, annual actuarial value Rs 4,500).
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Farmer with Pattadar Passbook (land >= 0.1 acres); age 18 to 59.

translations.te: రైతు బీమా — తెలంగాణ రైతులకు రూ. 5 లక్షల ఉచిత జీవిత బీమా.
translations.hi: रैतु बीमा — तेलंगाना किसानों के लिए ₹5 लाख का निःशुल्क जीवन बीमा।
translations.kn: ರೈತು ಬೀಮಾ — ರೈತರಿಗೆ ರೂ. 5 ಲಕ್ಷ ಉಚಿತ ಜೀವ ವಿಮೆ.
translations.ta: ரைத்து பீமா — விவசாயிகளுக்கு ரூ.5 லட்சம் இலவச காப்பீடு.

name: Telangana Dalit Bandhu Enterprise Grant
benefits: One-time Rs 10,00,000 non-repayable capital grant (annualized Rs 1,00,000 over 10 yrs) for SC self-employment unit.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Category SC; age 21 to 55; annual income <= Rs 1,50,000; BPL household.

translations.te: దళిత బంధు — తెలంగాణ ఎస్సీ కుటుంబాలకు స్వయం ఉపాధి కోసం రూ. 10 లక్షల ఆర్థిక సహాయం.
translations.hi: दलित बंधु — तेलंगाना एससी परिवारों को स्वरोजगार हेतु ₹10 लाख का अनुदान।
translations.kn: ದಲಿತ ಬಂಧು — ಎಸ್‌ಸಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಅನುದಾನ.
translations.ta: தலித் பந்து — பட்டியலின குடும்பங்களுக்கு சுயதொழில் மானியம்.

name: TS SC Corporation Economic Support Subsidy
benefits: Up to Rs 80,000 subsidy (80% on Rs 1L unit) for SC agriculture allied or micro-business unit.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Category SC; age 21 to 55; annual income <= Rs 2,00,000.

translations.te: తెలంగాణ ఎస్సీ కార్పొరేషన్ సబ్సిడీ రుణం — రూ. 80,000 వరకు సబ్సిడీ.
translations.hi: तेलंगाना एससी कॉर्पोरेशन सब्सिडी ऋण — ₹80,000 तक अनुदान।
translations.kn: ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ಎಸ್‌ಸಿ ಕಾರ್ಪೊರೇಷನ್ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ ಸಾಲ.
translations.ta: தெலங்கானா எஸ்சி கழகம் மானியக் கடன்.

name: Telangana Gruha Jyothi (200 Units Free Power)
benefits: Up to 200 units free domestic electricity per month (annual savings ~Rs 14,400).
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; BPL / White Ration Card holder; annual income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: గృహ జ్యోతి — నెలకు 200 యూనిట్ల వరకు ఉచిత విద్యుత్.
translations.hi: गृह ज्योति — प्रति माह 200 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क बिजली।
translations.kn: ಗೃಹ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ — ಮಾಸಿಕ 200 ಯೂನಿಟ್ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್.
translations.ta: கிரஹ ஜோதி — மாதம் 200 யூனிட் இலவச மின்சாரம்.

name: Indiramma Indlu Housing Scheme
benefits: Rs 5,00,000 grant for house construction (annualized Rs 50,000) for homeless BPL families; priority for SC/ST.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 2,00,000; age >= 18; priority SC/ST/OBC.

translations.te: ఇందిరమ్మ ఇండ్లు — పేద కుటుంబాలకు ఇంటి నిర్మాణం కోసం రూ. 5 లక్షల సహాయం.
translations.hi: इंदिरम्मा इंद्लु — बेघर परिवारों को घर निर्माण हेतु ₹5 लाख सहायता।
translations.kn: ಇಂದಿರಮ್ಮ ಇಂಡ್ಲು ವಸತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
translations.ta: இந்திரம்மா வீட்டு வசதித் திட்டம்.

name: Telangana Cheyutha / Aasara Social Security Pension
benefits: Rs 4,000/month (Rs 48,000/year) pension for elderly (57+), widows, or persons with disabilities.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 1,50,000; age >= 57.

translations.te: ఆసరా / చేయూత పింఛను — వృద్ధులు మరియు వితంతువులకు నెలకు రూ. 4,000 పింఛను.
translations.hi: आसरा / चेयुता पेंशन — बुजुर्गों और विधवाओं को ₹4,000/माह पेंशन।
translations.kn: ಆಸರಾ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
translations.ta: ஆசரா ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்.

name: Telangana Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak
benefits: Rs 1,00,116 marriage financial assistance grant for brides from SC/ST/BC/Minority families.
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; Female; age 18 to 35; Category SC/ST/OBC/Minority; annual income <= Rs 2,00,000.

translations.te: కళ్యాణ లక్ష్మి / షాదీ ముబారక్ — వధువు వివాహానికి రూ. 1,00,116 ఆర్థిక సహాయం.
translations.hi: कल्याण लक्ष्मी / शादी मुबारक — विवाह हेतु ₹1,00,116 सहायता।
translations.kn: ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
translations.ta: கல்யாண லட்சுமி திட்டம்.

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Insurance (Telangana)
benefits: Cashless tertiary medical treatment cover up to Rs 10,00,000 per family/year (annualized premium value Rs 6,000).
eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana; BPL / White Ration Card holder; annual income <= Rs 2,00,000.

translations.te: రాజీవ్ ఆరోగ్యశ్రీ — సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 10 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత వైద్యం.
translations.hi: राजीव आरोग्यश्री — ₹10 लाख तक निःशुल्क कैशलेस चिकित्सा।
translations.kn: ರಾಜೀವ್ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಶ್ರೀ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆ.
translations.ta: ராஜீவ் ஆரோக்கியஸ்ரீ மருத்துவ காப்பீடு.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility_text: All India resident; Occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 0.1 acres; age >= 18; annual family income <= Rs 4,00,000 (non-income-tax-payer).

translations.te: పీఎం-కిసాన్ సమ్మాన్ నిధి — రైతులకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 6,000 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ.
translations.hi: पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि — पात्र किसानों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ-ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಸಮ್ಮಾನ್ ನಿಧಿ — ರೈತರಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 6,000 ನೇರ ನಗದು ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ.
translations.ta: பிஎம்-கிசான் சம்மான் நிதி — விவசாயிகளுக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ.6,000 நேரடி நிதி உதவி.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefits: Subsidized crop insurance (farmer pays max 2% Kharif / 1.5% Rabi; avg claim protection value Rs 12,000/yr).
eligibility_text: All India; Occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 0.2 acres; age >= 18.

translations.te: ప్రధాన మంత్రి ఫసల్ బీమా యోజన — పంట నష్టానికి తక్కువ ప్రీమియంతో పంట బీమా.
translations.hi: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना — कम प्रीमियम पर फसल नुकसान से सुरक्षा।
translations.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಫಸಲ್ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ.
translations.ta: பிரதமர் பயிர் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம் — குறைந்த பிரிமியத்தில் பயிர் காப்பீடு.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Interest Subvention
benefits: Short-term crop credit up to Rs 3,00,000 at 4% effective interest (annual interest subsidy value ~Rs 9,000).
eligibility_text: All India; Occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 0.5 acres; age 18 to 75.

translations.te: కిసాన్ క్రెడిట్ కార్డ్ — 4% వడ్డీతో రూ. 3 లక్షల వరకు పంట రుణం.
translations.hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड — 4% प्रभावी ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक फसल ऋण।
translations.kn: ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ — 4% ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಾಲ.
translations.ta: கிசான் கிரெடிட் கார்டு — 4% வட்டியில் பயிர்க்கடன்.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Subsidy (Component B)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: 60% combined Central+State subsidy on standalone solar agricultural pumps (annualized savings Rs 24,000).
eligibility_text: All India; Occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 1.0 acres; age >= 18; Rural residence.

translations.te: పీఎం-కుసుమ్ — రైతులకు 60% సబ్సిడీతో సోలార్ పంప్ సెట్.
translations.hi: पीएम-कुसुम — किसानों को सोलर पंप पर 60% सब्सिडी।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ-ಕುಸುಮ್ — ಸೌರ ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್‌ಗೆ 60% ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ.
translations.ta: பிஎம்-குசும் — சூரிய சக்தி பம்ப்செட்டுக்கு 60% மானியம்.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Assurance
benefits: Rs 5,00,000 cashless hospitalization cover per family per year across empanelled hospitals (value Rs 5,000/yr).
eligibility_text: All India; BPL / SECC-2011 deprived household; annual income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ పీఎం-జెఎవై — కుటుంబానికి రూ. 5 లక్షల ఉచిత వైద్య బీమా.
translations.hi: आयुष्मान भारत पीएम-जय — प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख का निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
translations.kn: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ ಪಿಎಂ-ಜಯ — ಪ್ರತಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ರೂ. 5 ಲಕ್ಷ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆ.
translations.ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் — குடும்பத்திற்கு ரூ.5 லட்சம் மருத்துவ காப்பீடு.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefits: Rs 1,20,000 (plains) / Rs 1,30,000 (hilly) pucca house grant + 90 days MGNREGA wages (annualized Rs 28,000).
eligibility_text: All India; Rural residence; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 1,50,000; age >= 18.

translations.te: పీఎం ఆవాస్ యోజన గ్రామీణ — గ్రామీణ పేదలకు పక్కా ఇల్లు నిర్మాణానికి రూ. 1.20 లక్షల సహాయం.
translations.hi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना ग्रामीण — ग्रामीण गरीबों को पक्का मकान हेतु ₹1.20 लाख सहायता।
translations.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಆವಾಸ್ ಯೋಜನೆ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ — ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ಸಹಾಯ.
translations.ta: பிரதமர் ஊரக வீட்டு வசதித் திட்டம் — வீடு கட்ட ரூ.1.20 லட்சம் மானியம்.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
benefits: Up to Rs 2,50,000 interest subsidy / BLC construction grant for EWS/LIG urban families (annualized Rs 32,000).
eligibility_text: All India; Urban residence; annual income <= Rs 3,00,000 (EWS); age >= 18.

translations.te: పీఎం ఆవాస్ యోజన అర్బన్ — పట్టణ పేదలకు రూ. 2.5 లక్షల వరకు గృహ సబ్సిడీ.
translations.hi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना शहरी — शहरी परिवारों को ₹2.5 लाख तक आवास सब्सिडी।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ ಆವಾಸ್ ಯೋಜನೆ ನಗರ — ವಸತಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
translations.ta: பிரதமர் நகர்ப்புற வீட்டு வசதித் திட்டம்.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection + Rs 300/cylinder targeted subsidy (12 cylinders = Rs 3,600/yr + Rs 1,600 kit).
eligibility_text: All India; Female; age >= 18; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 2,00,000.

translations.te: ఉజ్వల యోజన — బీపీఎల్ మహిళలకు ఉచిత గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్ మరియు సిలిండర్ సబ్సిడీ.
translations.hi: प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना — बीपीएल महिलाओं को निःशुल्क एलपीजी कनेक्शन और ₹300 सब्सिडी।
translations.kn: ಉಜ್ವಲ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಎಲ್‌ಪಿಜಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ.
translations.ta: உஜ்வாலா திட்டம் — பெண்களுக்கு இலவச சமையல் எரிவாயு இணைப்பு.

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (100 Days Wage Guarantee)
benefits: 100 days guaranteed rural unskilled wage employment (~Rs 300/day = Rs 30,000/year per rural household).
eligibility_text: All India; Rural residence; age >= 18; occupation Farmer / Agricultural Laborer / Unemployed / Artisan.

translations.te: ఉపాధి హామీ (MGNREGA) — గ్రామీణ కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి 100 రోజుల పని హామీ.
translations.hi: मनरेगा (MGNREGA) — ग्रामीण परिवारों को वर्ष में 100 दिन का गारंटीकृत रोजगार।
translations.kn: ನರೇಗಾ (MGNREGA) — ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ 100 ದಿನಗಳ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಖಾತರಿ.
translations.ta: மகாத்மா காந்தி தேசிய ஊரக வேலை உறுதித் திட்டம் (100 நாள் வேலை).

name: PM Vishwakarma Artisan Support Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefits: Rs 15,000 toolkit e-voucher + Rs 500/day skill stipend + collateral-free loan up to Rs 3 lakh at 5% interest.
eligibility_text: All India; Occupation Artisan / Self-Employed; age >= 18; annual income <= Rs 3,00,000.

translations.te: పీఎం విశ్వకర్మ — చేతివృత్తుల వారికి రూ. 15,000 టూల్ కిట్ మరియు 5% వడ్డీతో రుణం.
translations.hi: पीएम विश्वकर्मा — कारीगरों को ₹15,000 टूलकिट और 5% ब्याज पर ऋण।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ ವಿಶ್ವಕರ್ಮ — ಕುಶಲಕರ್ಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ರೂ. 15,000 ಟೂಲ್‌ಕಿಟ್ ಸಹಾಯ.
translations.ta: பிஎம் விஸ்வகர்மா — கைவினைஞர்களுக்கு ரூ.15,000 கருவித்தொகுப்பு உதவி.

name: Stand-Up India SC/ST/Women Enterprise Scheme
benefits: Bank loan Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore with credit guarantee & handholding for greenfield enterprise (interest subsidy eq. Rs 45,000/yr).
eligibility_text: All India; Age >= 18; Category SC or ST (or Female entrepreneur); Occupation Self-Employed / Farmer / Artisan / Unemployed.

translations.te: స్టాండ్-అప్ ఇండియా — ఎస్సీ/ఎస్టీ మరియు మహిళా పారిశ్రామికవేత్తలకు రూ. 10 లక్షల నుండి రూ. 1 కోటి వరకు రుణం.
translations.hi: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया — एससी/एसटी और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ ऋण।
translations.kn: ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಂಡ್-ಅಪ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ — ಎಸ್‌ಸಿ/ಎಸ್‌ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ.
translations.ta: ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் இந்தியா — பட்டியலின மற்றும் பெண் தொழில்முனைவோர் கடன்.

name: Central Sector Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement + academic allowance up to Rs 13,500/year directly to student bank account.
eligibility_text: All India; Category SC; Occupation Student; age 15 to 30; annual family income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: ఎస్సీ పోస్ట్-మెట్రిక్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ — ట్యూషన్ ఫీజు మరియు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 13,500 వరకు భత్యం.
translations.hi: अनुसूचित जाति पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति — ट्यूशन शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति और ₹13,500 वार्षिक भत्ता।
translations.kn: ಎಸ್‌ಸಿ ಪೋಸ್ಟ್-ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ — ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ.
translations.ta: பட்டியலின மாணவர் மேனிலை கல்வி உதவித்தொகை.

name: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT
benefits: Academic allowance up to Rs 20,000/year for OBC/EBC students in post-matric and professional courses.
eligibility_text: All India; Category OBC or EWS; Occupation Student; age 15 to 28; annual family income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: పీఎం-యశస్వి ఓబీసీ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ — విద్యార్థులకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 20,000 వరకు సహాయం.
translations.hi: पीएम-यशस्वी ओबीसी छात्रवृत्ति — छात्रों को ₹20,000 प्रति वर्ष तक सहायता।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ-ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಒಬಿಸಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
translations.ta: பிஎம்-யசஸ்வி பிற்படுத்தப்பட்டோர் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
benefits: Monthly central pension Rs 200-500/month + state top-up (avg Rs 12,000/year) for BPL seniors aged 60+.
eligibility_text: All India; Age >= 60; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 1,00,000.

translations.te: ఇందిరా గాంధీ జాతీయ వృద్ధాప్య పింఛను — 60 ఏళ్లు పైబడిన బీపీఎల్ వృద్ధులకు నెలవారీ పింఛను.
translations.hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन — 60+ बीपीएल वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को मासिक पेंशन।
translations.kn: ಇಂದಿರಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ.
translations.ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
benefits: Monthly disability pension + assistive aid support (avg Rs 18,000/year with state matching).
eligibility_text: All India; Person with benchmark disability (>=80% severe); age 18 to 79; BPL household; annual income <= Rs 1,50,000.

translations.te: జాతీయ దివ్యాంగుల పింఛను పథకం — దివ్యాంగులకు నెలవారీ ఆర్థిక సహాయం.
translations.hi: राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना — दिव्यांगजनों को मासिक पेंशन।
translations.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಅಂಗವಿಕಲರ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
translations.ta: தேசிய மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகள் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்.

name: ADIP Scheme for Assistive Devices (Divyangjan)
benefits: Free motorized tricycle, hearing aids, or prosthetics up to Rs 25,000 (annualized Rs 12,500).
eligibility_text: All India; Person with benchmark disability (>=40%); annual family income <= Rs 2,70,000.

translations.te: ADIP పథకం — దివ్యాంగులకు ఉచిత సహాయక పరికరాలు.
translations.hi: एडिप योजना — दिव्यांगजनों को निःशुल्क सहायक उपकरण।
translations.kn: ಎಡಿಐಪಿ — ಅಂಗವಿಕಲರಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಸಾಧನಗಳು.
translations.ta: மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகளுக்கான இலவச உதவி உபகரணத் திட்டம்.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0)
benefits: Rs 5,000 maternity cash incentive for first child and Rs 6,000 for second girl child.
eligibility_text: All India; Female; age 19 to 45; annual family income <= Rs 8,00,000.

translations.te: ప్రధాన మంత్రి మాతృ వందన యోజన — గర్భిణీ మహిళలకు రూ. 5,000–6,000 సహాయం.
translations.hi: प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना — गर्भवती महिलाओं को ₹5,000–₹6,000 मातृत्व लाभ।
translations.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಮಾತೃ ವಂದನಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.
translations.ta: பிரதமர் மாத்ரு வந்தனா மகப்பேறு உதவித்தொகை.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (Shishu/Kishor Micro-Enterprise Loan)
benefits: Collateral-free micro-business loan up to Rs 5,00,000 with credit guarantee (annual credit benefit ~Rs 18,000).
eligibility_text: All India; Age 18 to 65; Occupation Self-Employed / Artisan / Unemployed; annual income <= Rs 6,00,000.

translations.te: పీఎం ముద్ర లోన్ — చిన్న వ్యాపారులకు హామీ లేకుండా రూ. 5 లక్షల వరకు రుణం.
translations.hi: पीएम मुद्रा योजना — सूक्ष्म व्यवसाय हेतु बिना गारंटी ₹5 लाख तक ऋण।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ ಮುದ್ರಾ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮ ಸಾಲ.
translations.ta: பிரதமர் முத்ரா கடன் திட்டம் — சிறு தொழில் கடன்.

name: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Micro-Credit
benefits: Working capital loan Rs 10k-50k + 7% interest subsidy + Rs 1,200/yr digital cashback.
eligibility_text: All India; Urban residence; Occupation Self-Employed / Artisan; age >= 18; annual income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: పీఎం స్వనిధి — వీధి వ్యాపారులకు 7% వడ్డీ సబ్సిడీతో వర్కింగ్ క్యాపిటల్ రుణం.
translations.hi: पीएम स्वनिधि — रेहड़ी-पटरी विक्रेताओं के लिए 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी ऋण।
translations.kn: ಪಿಎಂ ಸ್ವನಿಧಿ — ಬೀದಿ ಬದಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ.
translations.ta: பிஎம் ஸ்வநிதி — தெருவோர வியாபாரிகள் கடன் திட்டம்.

name: Andhra Pradesh Annadata Sukhibhava
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: Rs 20,000 per year investment assistance to AP farmer families (inclusive of PM-KISAN top-up; state share Rs 14,000).
eligibility_text: Resident of Andhra Pradesh; Occupation Farmer; cultivable land >= 0.2 acres; age >= 18; annual income <= Rs 4,00,000.

translations.te: అన్నదాత సుఖీభవ — ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రైతులకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 20,000 పంట పెట్టుబడి సహాయం.
translations.hi: अन्नदाता सुखीभव — आंध्र प्रदेश किसानों को ₹20,000 वार्षिक निवेश सहायता।
translations.kn: ಅನ್ನದಾತ ಸುಖೀಭವ — ಆಂಧ್ರಪ್ರದೇಶ ರೈತರ ನೆರವು.
translations.ta: அன்னதாதா சுகிபவா — ஆந்திர விவசாயிகள் உதவித்தொகை.

name: Andhra Pradesh Talliki Vandanam
ministry: School Education Dept, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
benefits: Rs 15,000 per year per school-going child deposited to mother's bank account.
eligibility_text: Resident of Andhra Pradesh; Female mother/guardian; BPL / Rice Card holder; annual income <= Rs 2,50,000.

translations.te: తల్లికి వందనం — పాఠశాలకు వెళ్లే ప్రతి బిడ్డకు తల్లి ఖాతాలో రూ. 15,000.
translations.hi: तल्लिकी वंदनम — आंध्र प्रदेश में प्रति छात्र ₹15,000 वार्षिक सहायता।
translations.kn: ತಲ್ಲಿಕಿ ವಂದನಂ — ಶಾಲಾ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 15,000.
translations.ta: தல்லிகி வந்தனம் — பள்ளி மாணவர் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Guarantee Scheme
ministry: Dept of Women & Child Development, Karnataka
benefits: Rs 2,000/month (Rs 24,000/year) direct benefit transfer to women heads of BPL/APL non-taxpayer families.
eligibility_text: Resident of Karnataka; Female head of household; age >= 18; annual family income <= Rs 2,00,000; BPL/Antyodaya card.

translations.te: కర్ణాటక గృహ లక్ష్మి — మహిళా కుటుంబ పెద్దలకు నెలకు రూ. 2,000.
translations.hi: कर्नाटक गृह लक्ष्मी — महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000/माह सीधे खाते में।
translations.kn: ಗೃಹ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಯಜಮಾನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ರೂ. 2,000 ನೇರ ನಗದು ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ.
translations.ta: கர்நாடகா கிரஹ லட்சுமி — குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.2,000.

name: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi Free Electricity
benefits: Up to 200 units free domestic electricity per month (annual savings ~Rs 14,400).
eligibility_text: Resident of Karnataka; age >= 18; domestic electricity consumer; annual income <= Rs 5,00,000.

translations.te: కర్ణాటక గృహ జ్యోతి — 200 యూనిట్ల ఉచిత విద్యుత్.
translations.hi: कर्नाटक गृह ज्योति — 200 यूनिट निःशुल्क घरेलू बिजली।
translations.kn: ಗೃಹ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು 200 ಯೂನಿಟ್ ವರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್.
translations.ta: கர்நாடகா கிரஹ ஜோதி — 200 யூனிட் இலவச மின்சாரம்.

name: Karnataka Shakti Free Bus Travel for Women
benefits: Zero-ticket travel in KSRTC/BMTC/NWKRTC/KKRTC non-luxury buses across Karnataka (~Rs 12,000/yr savings).
eligibility_text: Resident of Karnataka; Female; age >= 6.

translations.te: కర్ణాటక శక్తి పథకం — మహిళలకు ఉచిత బస్సు ప్రయాణం.
translations.hi: कर्नाटक शक्ति योजना — महिलाओं के लिए निःशुल्क बस यात्रा।
translations.kn: ಶಕ್ತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ — ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಬಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ.
translations.ta: கர்நாடகா சக்தி திட்டம் — பெண்களுக்கு இலவச பேருந்து பயணம்.

name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Unemployment Assistance
ministry: Skill Development Dept, Govt of Karnataka
benefits: Rs 3,000/month for unemployed graduates (Rs 36,000/yr) and Rs 1,500/month for diploma holders for 2 years.
eligibility_text: Resident of Karnataka; Occupation Unemployed; age 20 to 30; annual income <= Rs 3,00,000.

translations.te: కర్ణాటక యువ నిధి — నిరుద్యోగ గ్రాడ్యుయేట్లకు నెలకు రూ. 3,000.
translations.hi: कर्नाटक युवा निधि — बेरोजगार स्नातकों को ₹3,000/माह भत्ता।
translations.kn: ಯುವ ನಿಧಿ ಯೋಜನೆ — ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ರೂ. 3,000 ಭತ್ಯೆ.
translations.ta: கர்நாடகா யுவ நிதி — வேலையில்லா பட்டதாரிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.3,000.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu)
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Dept, Tamil Nadu
benefits: Rs 1,000/month (Rs 12,000/year) basic rights grant deposited to women heads of eligible families.
eligibility_text: Resident of Tamil Nadu; Female; age >= 21; annual family income <= Rs 2,50,000; land <= 5 acres.

translations.te: కళైஞర్ మగళిర్ ఉరిమై తొగై — తమిళనాడు మహిళలకు నెలకు రూ. 1,000.
translations.hi: कलैगनार मगलिर उरिमई थोगई — तमिलनाडु की महिलाओं को ₹1,000/माह।
translations.kn: ಕಲೈஞರ್ ಮಗಳಿರ್ ಉರಿಮೈ ತೊಗೈ — ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ರೂ. 1,000.
translations.ta: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் தொகை — குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ.1,000 நேரடி உதவி.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Pudhumai Penn Scheme
ministry: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Dept, TN
benefits: Rs 1,000/month (Rs 12,000/year) scholarship to girl students pursuing higher education after govt school.
eligibility_text: Resident of Tamil Nadu; Female; Occupation Student; age 17 to 25; annual income <= Rs 3,00,000.
